$comment: Tool-neutral hook manifest — the single source of truth for lifecycle hooks.
Each tool's adapter lives in scripts/generate-hooks.mjs and maps these events and tool
names onto whatever that tool calls them. Events: 'before-tool' (may block),
notebook-edit | shell. Scripts are referenced in place, not copied: the generator only
writes the wiring, so the code has exactly one home.
Kill switch for all of them: touch .agent/hooks/.disabled

hooks.description: Blocks a write into the main checkout before it happens.
Asks git what actually changed, catching writes no regex can predict.
Restates the worktree rule each turn so it survives compaction.
